notes: Mother of Emma Virginia Bell (McKeldin). Elmira in the 1900 census (aged 42) and Ella in 1920 (aged 62), born in Maryland. Her maiden name was Flaherty: the Social Security applications of her children Charles Alexander, William Ambrose and Emma Virginia give their mother as Elmira or Ella Flaherty (spelled Flaharty and Flagharty as well). Margaret "Clayhardy", 73, the mother-in-law in William Bell's 1900 household, is her mother Margaret Flaherty, mis-indexed.

Born June 1857 in Maryland (the FamilySearch tree, from the censuses), daughter of Thomas and Margaret Flaherty of Baltimore's 18th ward: Almira, 3, in 1860 with Thos. and Margaret Fleeharty, and 13 in 1870 with Thomas and Margaret Fleharty, her sister Mary M. and brother Charles. Her brother Charles, 14, lived with her and William in 1880. Her death is not yet found; she was alive in January 1920.
